_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Nekk d Ammukel {player_id} di Three-Player Tic Tac Toe.
Tazmilt-ik d '{symbol}'.
Tettnuḍḍayen ad tɛsseɣ takat n tablatt 5x5 i wakken ad teskelsiḍ aḍḍay n kuẓ.
Aḍḍisen zemren ad illin ḥiza, amadal, neɣ azɣiz.
Sekkelsiḍ aḍay-ik s usekkil '[4]' i wakken ad teskelsiḍ takat 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: ⵓⵔ ⵉⴳⵉ ⵓⵍⵖⵓ ⵏ ⵓⵙⵎⵓⵜⵜⴳ ⴰⵣⵔⴼⴰⵏ. ⵙⵙⵔⵙ "[cell]" ⴳ ⵜⴳⴰ ⵜⵖⵔⴰⵙⵜ 0-{max_cell} .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Akud n tcella yawi: {cell}. Ila ḥeqqen ɣef wayyur 0 d {max_cell}.
invalid_move.made_invalid: ⴰⵎⵓⵔⴰⵔ {player_id} ⵉⵙⴽⵔ ⵢⴰⵜ ⵜⵉⴼⵉⵣⵉⵔⵜ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉⵏ.

game_action.placed: Amɣid {player_id} isekka adlis nns ({symbol}) ɣef tirra ({row}, {col}).
